version_note: Hilux CS400 hardware list (rules + per-typology counts). Where the sheet and the EvA golden disagree, the rules reproduce EvA and the note says SHEET SAYS. Profiles, member rules and deductions are the CS400 v1 values reverse-engineered from EvA. Notes with ASSUMPTION/SHEET SAYS/CHECK are open in doc/hilux-questions.md.

hardware_rules.name: 14X32MM ADJUSTABLE CORNER CLEAT (PRIMIUM)
hardware_rules.note: 1 per frame corner

hardware_rules.name: 14X32MM ADJUSTABLE CORNER CLEAT (PRIMIUM)
hardware_rules.note: 1 per shutter corner

hardware_rules.name: SS CHEVERON 35X10X1.2MM
hardware_rules.note: Sheet counts 4/4/8/12/16: 1 per frame corner

hardware_rules.name: SS CHEVERON 35X10X1.2MM
hardware_rules.note: Sheet counts 4/4/8/12/16: 1 per shutter corner (prose says '& shutter 1 nos'; counts followed)

hardware_rules.name: SS CHEVERON 35X14 X1.2MM
hardware_rules.note: Not used: EvA W01/W02 have no H407. SHEET SAYS: 1 per frame corner, 4 on every window type (question Q2.5)

hardware_rules.name: MS CHEVERON 40X20.6 X 3MM
hardware_rules.note: Not used: EvA W01 has no H408. SHEET SAYS: 1 per shutter corner, 4/8/12 for single/double/triple open (question Q2.6)

hardware_rules.name: ss screw 8 x 50 for Mullion fixing
hardware_rules.note: 4 per mullion (Hilux prose, sheet counts and EvA W01 agree)

hardware_rules.name: Window Hinge 2 wing
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: 2 per shutter (Hilux: 2 to 4) and only when the sash hinge type is butt, replacing the friction hinges

hardware_rules.name: Friction hinge 12 inch
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: 12 inch up to 600 mm sash width, 14 inch above. Hilux '2 nos per shutter' = 1 pair (Item H416 is stocked in Pairs)

hardware_rules.name: Friction hinge 14 inch
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: 14 inch above 600 mm sash width. Hilux '2 nos per shutter' = 1 pair, same unit as H416

hardware_rules.name: 600mm Transmission Rod for window shutter
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: rod by sash height (sash height under 700 mm), only with the multipoint handle; Hilux: 'calculated based on shutter height'

hardware_rules.name: 800mm Transmission Rod for window shutter
hardware_rules.when: handle == 'multipoint' and sash_h >= rod_800_min_h and sash_h < rod_1200_min_h
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: rod by sash height (700 to under 1000 mm), only with the multipoint handle; Hilux: 'calculated based on shutter height'

hardware_rules.name: 1200mm Transmission Rod for window shutter
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: rod by sash height (1000 mm and over), only with the multipoint handle; Hilux: 'calculated based on shutter height'

hardware_rules.name: Locking Plate
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: 2 per window shutter (the 3 is for doors), only with the multipoint handle

hardware_rules.name: window handle multipoint
hardware_rules.note: 1 per shutter, as EvA W01. SHEET SAYS: 2 nos per shutter (question Q4.1)

hardware_rules.name: Opening Limiter
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: 'if needed' = the sash's opening limiter option

hardware_rules.name: Casement Single point handle
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: replaces the multipoint handle, rod and locking plates when the sash handle is single point

hardware_rules.name: 8 x13 SS screw for Friction hinge fixing
hardware_rules.note: 6 per shutter = 6 per friction-hinge pair (H416/H417 are stocked in Pairs), as EvA W01. SHEET SAYS: 6 per friction hinge, 2 hinges per shutter = 12 (question Q3.5)

hardware_rules.name: frame Gasket for casement
hardware_rules.note: Frame and every sash outer sides, as EvA. ASSUMPTION: the sheet's 'and fixed glass' means the fixed-glass G29/G23 lines, not more G21 (question Q5.1)

hardware_rules.name: gasket for 2mm glass
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: glazing gasket by glass thickness, 1 mm gasket step per 1 mm glass (over 6 to 8 mm glass); thicker glass (DGU, laminates over 8 mm) gets no gasket and a no_glazing_gasket warning. Hilux 'x 2 sides/1side' read as 1 side, like EvA W01

hardware_rules.name: gasket for 3mm glass
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: glazing gasket by glass thickness, 1 mm gasket step per 1 mm glass (5-6 mm glass, as Task 1 / EvA W01 6 mm); thicker glass (DGU, laminates over 8 mm) gets no gasket and a no_glazing_gasket warning. Hilux 'x 2 sides/1side' read as 1 side, like EvA W01

hardware_rules.name: gasket for 4mm glass
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: glazing gasket by glass thickness, 1 mm gasket step per 1 mm glass (4 to under 5 mm glass); thicker glass (DGU, laminates over 8 mm) gets no gasket and a no_glazing_gasket warning. Hilux 'x 2 sides/1side' read as 1 side, like EvA W01

hardware_rules.name: gasket for 5mm glass
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: glazing gasket by glass thickness, 1 mm gasket step per 1 mm glass (3 to under 4 mm glass); thicker glass (DGU, laminates over 8 mm) gets no gasket and a no_glazing_gasket warning. Hilux 'x 2 sides/1side' read as 1 side, like EvA W01

hardware_rules.name: Fly mesh fixing Gasket
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: mesh shutter perimeter = sash perimeter, 1 side, only on sashes with the fly mesh option

hardware_rules.name: frame Glass Gasket for casement
hardware_rules.note: Not used: EvA W02 glazes fixed panes with G21 + G23 only. SHEET SAYS: G29 on frames around fixed glass sides (question Q5.2)

hardware_rules.name: Frame Packer 5 mm
hardware_rules.note: 0.5 per fastener, rounded up per frame side (reproduces EvA W01 6 and W02 4)

hardware_rules.name: Frame Packer 3 mm
hardware_rules.note: 0.5 per fastener, rounded up per frame side (reproduces EvA W01 6 and W02 4)

hardware_rules.name: Frame Packer 2 mm
hardware_rules.note: 1 per fastener

hardware_rules.name: Frame Packer 1 mm
hardware_rules.note: 1 per fastener

hardware_rules.name: Glass Packer 2 mm
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: 8 per pane, fixed panes included (Hilux: 2 or 3 mm packer, 8 to 10 per shutter; EvA W01 8 per pane)

hardware_rules.name: Glass Packer 3 mm
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: not used by default; Hilux gives no rule for choosing 3 mm over 2 mm packers

hardware_rules.name: SS guid rail 13mm
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: sliding track rail ('per track x bottom'); casement windows have no track, so never used here

hardware_rules.name: 8x80 wall fixing fastener screw
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: EvA formula ceil(len/fastener_spacing) per frame side kept, fastener_spacing = 500 (reproduces EvA W01 2/3/2/3); Hilux: every 600 to 800 mm

hardware_rules.name: Hole cape
hardware_rules.note: 1 per fastener. ASSUMPTION: also on fixed windows (Hilux: not required; rules cannot yet tell a fixed window from the frame side, and EvA W02 charges them)

hardware_rules.name: WATER DRAINAGE CAP
hardware_rules.note: 1 per 600 mm of frame bottom + 1, max 6 (gives EvA W01 2 at 915 wide, sheet 3 for fixed at 1200). SHEET SAYS: 4 for open windows 1200 wide; no plain per-window rule tells open from fixed (question Q7.3)

hardware_rules.name: Sealant
hardware_rules.note: 2 x frame perimeter / 6 cans, as EvA W01 (1.423). Unit CAN = existing Item H914. SHEET SAYS: 1 bottle per window / 6 m frame length, 1 at 1200x1200 (question Q7.4)

hardware_rules.name: masking tape
hardware_rules.note: ASSUMPTION: 'frame running meter 2 sides x 2' read as 2 x frame perimeter (EvA W01 8.54 m)

validation_rules.message: Shutter {panel} weighs {shutter_kg} kg, above friction stay limit {max_shutter_kg} kg
validation_rules.hint: Use a larger stay, add a transom, or split the sash

LAM-8C-8C-152.name: 8+8Lami
LAM-8C-8C-152.note: CHECK: sheet labels it 17.52 and describes it as 8mm + 1.52 PVB + 6mm, which is 15.52. Code says 8+8, so 8+8+1.52 = 17.52 and glass_mm 16 are used. Confirm with Hilux.

LAM-8C-8C-228S.name: 8+8Lami (2.28 Sentry Lami)
LAM-8C-8C-228S.note: CHECK: sheet labels it 17.52 but 8+8 glass plus 2.28 Sentry interlayer is 18.28. 18.28 used. Confirm with Hilux.
